snippet.title: Lemoncholia (LEMON.wad) Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
An incredibly pleasant wad with a great aesthetic, as simple as it starts. 
From this and Kuchitsu, i have realized i am a big fan of these simplistic levels and looks. 
Each level is just long enough where you either get your fill, or maybe want more, but more of this i feel might spoil it's splendor. 
The midi's are also very fitting with the levels, being generally calmer more background style midi's which allow you space to experience the levels with the sounds alongside you. 
As a special note, the "Decontamination" machine in Map05 is an incredibly cool setpiece, very fun to see how these new custom imps are "made", although i do wish the machine turned off with the switch next to it. 

Map01 - Island Spaceport - 00:00
Map02 - Dream Home -  03:14
Map03 - Fissure - 06:36
Map04 - Dirge - 09:28
Map05 - Decontamination Site - 21:58
Map06 - Lastigi - 28:22
